newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool seen tending weaker this week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool seen tending weaker this week.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to be tested this week by the large offering on sale, Wesfarmers Dalgety Ltd said in its weekly market preview.
"Generally, the market is anticipated to tend weaker, however, this is not expected to be severe due to improving buyer confidence and grower resistance to a downturn in prices," Wesfarmers said.

Sales this week are in Sydney, Adelaide and Fremantle with 115,561 bales rostered. The large offering -- Sydney has an extra 20,813 bales compared to the last sale -- is likely to be a severe test for the market, it said.

In Sydney there are 41,990 bales of mostly best to good topmaking styles rostered, the large offering in Adelaide of 47,986 bales is mostly average to good topmaking styles and in Fremantle there is a small offering of 25,585 bales of mainly good topmaking types, Wesfarmers said.
The eastern market indicator last week fell by six cents to 570 cents a kg clean, while the western market indicator fell three cents to 530 cents a kg clean.
